_meta.title: Population domain graph — connectivity remediation (PROPOSAL ONLY)
_meta.purpose: Grounded feedback/reciprocal edges, reconnection edges, and redundant paths to remediate the findings from assets/js/energy-connectivity-audit.js (the audit module is domain-generic) run against assets/data/domains/population.json. This is a recommendation artifact; it does NOT modify any live graph.
_meta.discipline: Every proposed edge carries a concrete grounding (a canonical-nodes.json regulatory/anatomical fact OR the reciprocity of an existing population.json edge). Candidates that could not be grounded are omitted and tallied under _omittedForLackOfGrounding.
_meta.doNotApply: Do not merge these edges into assets/data/domains/population.json without an explicit apply step.
_meta.neuroReferenceThesis: Healthy circuits are ~80% recurrent/lateral; the network, not the node, is the unit of failure (diaschisis). A pure feedforward tree is the broken/cosmetic version; a graph FRACTURED INTO DISCONNECTED COMPONENTS is worse still.
_meta.pathologyVerdict: DIFFERENT FROM FINANCE. Finance's headline fault was a pure feedforward tree (recurrentFraction 0). Population is NOT a pure tree: it already carries 10 reciprocal edges (recurrentFraction 0.189, 5 feedback pairs) and clears the lateral benchmark (0.474). Population's headline fault is FRAGMENTATION: the graph is broken into THREE disconnected components at baseline (Energy=1, Finance=2). The main body is 30 nodes; a {CARD, RAPHE} mortality/aging health dyad is fully severed; and a large 10-node thalamo-sensory-cerebellar-basal-ganglia island {THAL, CBLM, GP, STRI, S1, A1, MGN, V1, FEF, LGN} is fully severed from the body. That whole sensory/relay/motor-loop subsystem cannot exchange signal with the demographic body at all.

recurrenceAudit.note: UNLIKE Finance/Energy (recurrentFraction 0), Population already has 5 reciprocal pairs among its business-layer authored edges, so recurrentFraction is 0.189 (just under the 0.2 tree-vs-mesh threshold) and lateralFraction 0.474 clears 0.2 -> module verdict is 'has recurrent/lateral structure', not TREE-LIKE. The recurrence dimension is present-but-thin; the dominant fault is fragmentation, handled below under singlePointsOfFailure.

singlePointsOfFailure.baseComponentsNote: THREE components at baseline. (1) Main body = 30 nodes. (2) {CARD, RAPHE} = a fully severed dyad (internal edges CARD<->RAPHE only; no edge to the body) = the mortality/aging health axis. (3) A fully severed 10-node island = {THAL, CBLM, GP, STRI, S1, A1, MGN, V1, FEF, LGN} = the entire thalamo-cortical sensory relay + basal-ganglia gate (STRI->GP->THAL) + cerebellum (CBLM->THAL) + frontal eye fields, with NO edge into the demographic body. This double fracture is the extra fault vs Finance (Finance baseComponents=2, one small {M1,SMA} dyad; Energy=1).
singlePointsOfFailure.articulationCountNote: The count is inflated by the pre-existing 3-component fracture: because {CARD, RAPHE} is already its own component, removing almost any body hub yields base+1 by also enumerating that pre-severed dyad. The TRUE per-node isolation each articulation causes (ignoring the ever-present severed dyad) is given in mechanismOfEachArticulation below.

mechanismOfEachArticulation.OXY: sole attachment of leaf SEPT (SEPT<->OXY is SEPT's only link to the body's interior chain)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.HYPO: sole attachment of the {OXY, SEPT} sub-chain (via OXY<->HYPO)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.VEST: sole attachment of leaf RSC (RSC->VEST is RSC's only edge)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.dlPFC: sole attachment of leaf TPJ (TPJ->dlPFC) and leaf FPN (FPN->dlPFC); also the top hub (degree 8)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.AI: sole attachment of leaves NTS (NTS->AI) and PI (PI->AI)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.M1: internal bridge; also the sole body-side anchor once the sensory island is reconnected via THAL->M1 (see reconnection edges)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.OFC: internal bridge in the valuation chain (NAcc->OFC->vmPFC)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.BLA: sole attachment of leaf rACC (rACC->BLA is rACC's only edge); degree-6 hub
mechanismOfEachArticulation.PVN: sole attachment of the {OXY, SEPT, HYPO} HPA sub-cluster (via PVN->HYPO)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.vmPFC: sole attachment of leaf PAG (vmPFC->PAG is PAG's only edge)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.HIPP: sole attachment of leaf HPA (HPA->HIPP is HPA's only edge)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.THAL: hub of the entire severed sensory island: isolates {V1, FEF, LGN}, {A1, MGN}, {S1}, {STRI, GP}, and {CBLM} on removal
mechanismOfEachArticulation.V1: sole attachment of leaf LGN (LGN->V1) and leaf FEF (FEF->V1) within the island
mechanismOfEachArticulation.A1: sole attachment of leaf MGN (MGN->A1) within the island
mechanismOfEachArticulation.NAcc: sole attachment of leaf VP (NAcc->VP is VP's only edge)
mechanismOfEachArticulation.GP: internal bridge of the basal-ganglia limb inside the island (STRI->GP->THAL)

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the conflict-monitoring -> cognitive-control loop: the conflict/error signal feeds back to the executive to adjust control gain.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge dlPFC->dACC (excit, 'executive recruits conflict monitor'). canonical-nodes dACC = M6 'conflict/error monitor', dlPFC = 'dorsolateral PFC — executive working-memory / cognitive control'. dACC<->dlPFC are reciprocally connected (Botvinick conflict-control loop).

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the salience-network loop; the two salience hubs must be mutually coupled to co-select what gets escalated.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge AI->dACC (excit, 'interoceptive -> conflict monitor'). canonical-nodes AI = M10 'interoceptive salience'; the anterior insula and dorsal ACC are the two defining hubs of the salience network and are reciprocally coupled by definition.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the value<->context loop; the context/valuation brake feeds back onto outcome valuation. Reciprocal of the existing OFC->vmPFC edge.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge OFC->vmPFC (excit, 'value -> context decision'). canonical-nodes vmPFC = M1 'top-down inhibitory brake', OFC = M6 'outcome valuation / update'; adjacent medial/orbital PFC regions with dense reciprocal connectivity.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the valuation<->reward loop; the outcome-valuation stage feeds back to the reward driver. Reciprocal of the existing NAcc->OFC edge.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge NAcc->OFC (excit, 'reward -> value coding'). The orbitofrontal cortex is a principal glutamatergic corticostriatal input to the ventral striatum / nucleus accumbens. canonical-nodes OFC = M6 valuation, NAcc = M11 'incentive/reward drive'.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the salience -> executive loop; the interoceptive/density-stress detector feeds the executive planner so control tracks internal load. Reciprocal of the existing dlPFC->AI edge.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge dlPFC->AI (CONTROLS). canonical-nodes AI = M10 interoceptive salience, dlPFC = executive control; anterior insula and dlPFC are reciprocally coupled across the salience/executive interface.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Corticothalamic feedback closing the somatosensory thalamo-cortical loop that THAL->S1 opens.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge THAL->S1 (excit, 'somatosensory relay'). Layer-6 corticothalamic feedback S1->VPL is one of the most numerous projection classes in the brain (feedback outnumbers feedforward), functionally gain/precision control -> modul. canonical-nodes S1 = 'primary somatosensory processing', THAL = M4 'gating relay / routing'.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Corticothalamic feedback closing the visual thalamo-cortical loop that THAL->V1 opens.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge THAL->V1 (excit, 'visual sensory relay'). V1->LGN/pulvinar corticothalamic feedback is canonical and modulatory.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Corticothalamic feedback closing the auditory thalamo-cortical loop that THAL->A1 opens.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge THAL->A1 (excit, 'auditory sensory relay'). A1->MGN corticothalamic feedback is canonical and modulatory.

proposedReconnectionEdges.fixes: component fracture — the severed {CARD, RAPHE} dyad
proposedReconnectionEdges.rationale: The {CARD, RAPHE} mortality/aging health dyad is a fully disconnected component (only internal edges CARD<->RAPHE). A serotonergic raphe -> amygdala projection reattaches the dyad to the main body (BLA is a body hub). Reduces baseComponents by merging comp {CARD,RAPHE} into the body.
proposedReconnectionEdges.grounding: canonical-nodes RAPHE = M2 'serotonin broadcast' (a diffuse neuromodulatory source, like LC = M2 which already projects LC->BLA in-graph). Serotonergic raphe nuclei project densely to the basolateral amygdala, modulating threat processing (textbook 5-HT neuromodulation). canonical-nodes BLA = M7 'threat learning/acquisition'.

proposedReconnectionEdges.fixes: component fracture — second anchor for CARD
proposedReconnectionEdges.rationale: Gives CARD a second, independent bridge to the body (beyond RAPHE), so that removing RAPHE does not re-sever the health dyad. The visceral-afferent hub carries baroreceptor/cardiovascular signal into the cardiovascular regulation center.
proposedReconnectionEdges.grounding: canonical-nodes NTS = M10 'visceral afferent hub'. The nucleus tractus solitarius is the first central relay of baroreceptor and cardiac afferents and drives the medullary cardiovascular center (baroreflex afferent limb) — a canonical NTS -> cardiovascular projection. CARD = the domain's cardiovascular/mortality regulation node.

proposedReconnectionEdges.fixes: component fracture — the severed 10-node thalamo-sensory island
proposedReconnectionEdges.rationale: Reattaches the entire severed sensory/relay island to the demographic body: the thalamus feeds the motor cortex (a body node), and the island's basal-ganglia limb STRI->GP->THAL then completes the cortico-basal-ganglia-thalamo-cortical loop through the body. Primary bridge dropping baseComponents 3->2 for the island.
proposedReconnectionEdges.grounding: canonical-nodes THAL = M4 'gating relay / routing', M1 = 'primary motor cortex — motor output'. The ventral-anterior/ventral-lateral thalamus -> M1 projection is the canonical thalamocortical motor relay and the return leg of the basal-ganglia loop already half-present in-graph (STRI->GP inhib, GP->THAL inhib).

proposedReconnectionEdges.fixes: component fracture — second bridge for the sensory island
proposedReconnectionEdges.rationale: Second independent bridge for the severed island, from the cortical (body) side: a corticostriatal projection into the island's striatum. Ensures removing M1 does not re-isolate the island (prevents THAL->M1 from making M1 a new single point of failure), and closes the motor loop from the body cortex into the island's basal-ganglia limb.
proposedReconnectionEdges.grounding: canonical-nodes SMA = 'supplementary motor — self-initiated action sequencing' (a body-side node in the main component). SMA is a principal cortical source of the motor corticostriatal projection to the putamen/striatum (canonical). STRI = composite basal-ganglia input node inside the island.

proposedReconnectionEdges.rationale: Closes the mesolimbic reward loop VTA->NAcc->VP->VTA (the hedonic-output stage feeds back to regulate the dopamine source), AND gives leaf VP a second anchor so removing NAcc does not isolate it. One edge serves both recurrence and de-articulation of NAcc.
proposedReconnectionEdges.grounding: In-graph the reward chain VTA->NAcc (excit) and NAcc->VP (inhib) already exists; the ventral pallidum sends GABAergic feedback to the VTA (canonical mesolimbic disinhibition loop). canonical-nodes VP = 'ventral pallidum — reward/hedonic output', VTA = M11 'dopamine reward source'.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: SEPT reaches the body only via SEPT<->OXY, so OXY (and upstream HYPO, PVN) are single points of failure for the whole {OXY, SEPT, HYPO} bonding/HPA sub-cluster. A septo-hippocampal edge gives SEPT a second anchor (HIPP is a body node), de-articulating OXY, HYPO, and PVN in one edge.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes SEPT = 'septal nuclei — theta rhythm / social reward', HIPP = M3 'HPA feedback + memory index'. The septo-hippocampal pathway (medial septum pacing hippocampal theta) is one of the most canonical subcortical projections.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: RSC reaches the body only via RSC->VEST, so VEST is a single point of failure for RSC. A retrosplenial-hippocampal edge gives RSC a second anchor; removing VEST then leaves RSC attached via HIPP.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes RSC = 'retrosplenial — spatial memory & navigation', HIPP = M3 memory index. The retrosplenial cortex is densely and reciprocally connected with the hippocampal formation as part of the spatial-memory / navigation system (canonical RSC-hippocampal circuit).

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: TPJ reaches the body only via TPJ->dlPFC. A mentalizing-network edge to medial PFC gives TPJ a second anchor; removing dlPFC then leaves TPJ attached via mPFC.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes TPJ = 'temporoparietal junction — social attribution & reorienting', mPFC = 'medial PFC — self-referential value integration (DMN core)'. TPJ and mPFC are the two core nodes of the theory-of-mind / mentalizing network and are functionally coupled (canonical social-cognition pairing).

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: FPN reaches the body only via FPN->dlPFC. A fronto-parietal -> cingulate edge gives FPN a second anchor; removing dlPFC then leaves FPN attached via dACC.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes FPN = composite 'fronto-parietal control network', dACC = M6 conflict/error monitor. The fronto-parietal control network is functionally coupled to the cingulo-opercular / salience hub dACC for control recruitment (canonical control-network coupling). NOTE: FPN is a composite view; the cleaner long-run fix is to decompose it, but the dACC coupling is defensible as-is.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: PI reaches the body only via PI->AI. A posterior/mid-insula -> cingulate edge gives PI a second anchor; removing AI then leaves PI attached via dACC.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes PI = M10 'primary interoception', dACC = M6 conflict monitor / salience hub. Posterior/mid-insula interoceptive signals project to the anterior cingulate as part of the interoception-salience pathway (canonical). Mirrors the Finance PI->dACC recommendation.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: rACC reaches the body only via rACC->BLA. A medial-PFC affective-regulation edge gives rACC a second anchor; removing BLA then leaves rACC attached via vmPFC.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes rACC = 'rostral ACC — affective appraisal & regulation', vmPFC = M1 top-down brake. rACC and vmPFC are adjacent ventromedial affective-regulation regions with reciprocal connectivity (the emotion-regulation medial-PFC cluster). Mirrors the Finance rACC->vmPFC recommendation.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: PAG reaches the body only via vmPFC->PAG. A central-amygdala -> PAG efferent gives PAG a second afferent; removing vmPFC then leaves PAG attached via CeA. Also closes the threat-appraisal -> defensive-output pathway.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes CeA = M7 'phasic fear output', PAG = M8 'defensive kill/lockdown'. The central-amygdala -> periaqueductal-gray projection is the textbook fear-output pathway. Mirrors the Finance CeA->PAG recommendation.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: HPA reaches the body only via HPA->HIPP. Cortisol also acts on the amygdala, giving HPA a second, well-grounded anchor; removing HIPP then leaves HPA attached via BLA.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: Glucocorticoid (HPA-axis) output acts on the basolateral amygdala via glucocorticoid receptors, enhancing threat processing (textbook stress endocrinology). canonical-nodes BLA = M7 'threat learning/acquisition'. NOTE: canonical-nodes marks HPA as a COMPOSITE view; the cleaner long-run fix is to remap HPA to a view rather than treat it as a node. Mirrors the Finance HPA->BLA recommendation.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: Inside the (now-reconnected) island, S1 hangs off THAL alone. A somatomotor edge gives S1 a second anchor via M1; removing THAL then leaves S1 attached via M1. Groundable only BECAUSE M1 is reconnected to the body by THAL->M1 / SMA->STRI above.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes S1 = 'primary somatosensory processing', M1 = 'primary motor cortex — motor output'. S1<->M1 somatomotor connectivity is dense and reciprocal (the sensorimotor strip). Recorded in Finance as a 'groundable future edge'; here it is added because M1 is on the graph and reconnected.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: Gives the auditory cortex a cortical anchor off the THAL hub, reattaching the auditory relay island {A1, MGN} to the body when THAL is removed (MGN then hangs off A1, A1 off AI).
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes AI = M10 'interoceptive salience'; auditory cortex projects to the insular cortex (auditory-to-insula projection is documented; the insula integrates auditory salience). Mirrors the Finance A1->AI recommendation.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: The {V1, FEF, LGN} visual fragment reaches the rest only through THAL (and internally FEF->V1, LGN->V1). A frontal-eye-field -> dlPFC edge gives the fragment a frontal anchor independent of THAL; removing THAL then leaves {V1, FEF} attached via FEF->dlPFC.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes FEF = 'frontal eye fields — attentional gaze control', dlPFC = executive control. FEF and dlPFC are both frontal nodes of the dorsal attention / oculomotor-cognitive interface and are directly connected (canonical frontal attention coupling). NOTE: LGN remains a leaf of V1 (dedicated retinal relay — see _omittedForLackOfGrounding).

projectedImpact.method: The 24 proposed edges (8 feedback + 5 reconnection + 11 redundant) were appended to a deep copy of population.json in memory and re-scored with assets/js/energy-connectivity-audit.js. population.json itself was NOT modified.

reciprocalEdges.note: the 8 new pairs are exactly the 8 proposedFeedbackEdges (each is the reverse of a pre-existing edge); the 5 pre-existing pairs are retained.

recurrentFraction.note: clears the 0.2 tree-vs-mesh threshold with margin; still well below the ~0.8 cortical benchmark, so further reciprocation remains available.

baseComponents.note: the {CARD, RAPHE} dyad is reconnected by RAPHE->BLA + NTS->CARD, and the 10-node thalamo-sensory island by THAL->M1 + SMA->STRI; the graph becomes a single connected body.

articulationNodes.reason: All three residual articulation points survive solely because a dedicated sensory/relay leaf has no second grounded projection target present in the graph, so its redundant path was omitted rather than fabricated: THAL still cuts off leaf CBLM; V1 still cuts off leaf LGN; A1 still cuts off leaf MGN. This is the SAME honest floor Finance and Energy bottomed out at (THAL/V1/A1 for the identical CBLM/LGN/MGN dedicated-relay reason).

candidates.candidate: redundant path around THAL via a second edge on CBLM
candidates.reason: CBLM reaches the graph only via CBLM->THAL. The thalamus does not project to the cerebellum, and cerebellar cortical input arrives polysynaptically via the pontine nuclei (no direct cortex->CBLM fiber to any in-graph node). No honest second edge, so CBLM stays a leaf of THAL and THAL stays a residual articulation point for it.

candidates.candidate: redundant path around V1 via a second edge on LGN
candidates.reason: LGN is a dedicated retino-recipient thalamic relay whose only cortical target is V1; the pulvinar / superior-colliculus partners that would give it a second grounded projection are not present as nodes in the population graph. LGN stays a leaf of V1.

candidates.candidate: redundant path around A1 via a second edge on MGN
candidates.reason: MGN is a dedicated cochlea-recipient (medial geniculate) auditory thalamic relay whose only cortical target is A1; no second grounded projection target exists among the graph's nodes. MGN stays a leaf of A1.

Hippocampal output to lateral PFC is not a monosynaptic projection; direct hippocampal-PFC fibers target mPFC/vmPFC, not dlPFC, and the mPFC relay is not on a population-graph edge path back to dlPFC. Cannot ground a direct HIPP->dlPFC edge. (Same omission as Finance.)

_omittedForLackOfGrounding.notedButNotOmitted: GP and STRI remain internal bridges of the basal-ganglia limb inside the reconnected island, but they are NOT articulation points after reconnection (the loop STRI->GP->THAL->M1 plus SMA->STRI gives that limb two body-side attachments), so no extra edge is proposed for them.
